segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Last month, my friend and I went to the mountains for a weekend trip. We left early on Saturday morning. The weather was sunny and warm. First, we took a bus to the small town near the mountains. The bus ride was about two hours. After that, we started to walk up the mountain. The path was easy at first, but then it became steep. We walked for three hours and finally reached the top. The view was beautiful. We took many photos. Then we had lunch at a small restaurant near the top. I ate noodles and my friend had rice. After lunch, we walked down the mountain. It started to rain, so we were wet and cold. We were tired but happy. Finally, we took a bus back home. We arrived home at 8 p.m. It was a great trip, and I want to go again next year. But next time, I will take a raincoat. Also, my friend said she wants to come too. We both agree it was a good weekend. The bus ride back was about two hours. We talked about the trip and looked at our photos. It was a long day, but we enjoyed it.
